title: My New School
objectives: Name school things and school subjects
Use the present simple for routines and the present continuous for now
Read a short letter and find who it is for
grammar: present simple: I walk to school every day.
present continuous: I am writing a letter now.

lost_letter.letter:
Dear Mr Tom,

My name is Mai. I am a new student at Star Valley School. Every morning I walk to school with my classmate Nam. We have English and maths on Monday.

Today I am writing this letter because I want to join the library club. Could you please give it to the librarian?

Thank you!
Mai
lost_letter.question: Who should get this letter?
lost_letter.hint: Đọc lại câu: "Could you please give it to the ...?"
